reviewNotes: Reviewed all 159 exported keys against 31 cards and explicit furigana in data/pages21a.json, pages21b.json and pages21c.json. Context-specific topic は, では, または and 上には rendered わ. Object を rendered お. No directional へ occurs; lexical へんか retained. Preserved lexical 葉 は, 花/鼻/華 はな, 発芽 はつが, 灰緑色 はいみどりいろ, 半分 はんぶん, 羽 はね, 針 はり, 薄片 はくへん, はっきり, はやく, はいり, はごたえ and はっこう. 葉は rendered はわ. Corrected speech-only typo in q19 香(かお)が to かおりが based on its aroma meaning and explanation; display and lookup key retained. Loanwords transcribed to hiragana with long vowels retained, including はーぶ, ぐりーんぴーす, ぺーすと, すぱいしー, ろーずまりー, せーじ, ちゃーびる, こりあんだー, よーぐると and でざーと. Explicit readings such as たでず, ちりめんざんしょう, こなざんしょう, しちみとうがらし, しょうのう, うもうじょう and あえごろも retained. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
